hypothesis: HYPE breakout-onset entries whose completed five-minute breakout direction agrees with the completed-hour structural direction may outperform entries where those directions oppose after live costs.
decision: Observe direction agreement prospectively without changing, gating, closing, or resizing the live strategy. Lifecycle HYPE:511104632491 is the first fully instrumented opposed sample: the provider entered long from completed-hour SMA structure while the completed five-minute breakout direction, 1m state, and 15m context were short or bearish. Preserve the protected live lifecycle and attribute its resolved outcome before considering a direction-selection change.
falsifier: Repeated resolved live entries showing opposed breakout/structure cases equal or outperform aligned cases after fees, funding, and slippage would reject an alignment preference; missing causal entry fields or changed source-prefix hashes would invalidate the comparison.
limitations: This is one open lifecycle and contains no resolved outcome evidence.
Older HYPE closes predate the measured breakout-side relation and cannot be relabeled without a separate causal reconstruction.
The component alignment score is descriptive and is not a fitted win probability.
A favorable or unfavorable result from one trade cannot establish a direction-selection edge.
